note: Gravel park in Drakesboro, reopened in 2024 under new owners (formerly English RV Park). Caters to contract workers at nearby plants and also takes overnighters. Self-contained RVs only: no restrooms or showers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed nightly $40-50 (monthly $585) for two adults and dependents, 39 full-hookup sites with 20/30/50A (two pull-throughs), WiFi, no restrooms/showers, open year-round, online booking via Let's Camp. Workforce-leaning but sells nights; nightly share unmeasured.
